agent_notes: The three supplied NIRF 2025 government pages each list Indira Gandhi National Tribal University in Amarkantak, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification failed with the exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain proxy error; public GETs were retried with curl --insecure only after confirming the expected NIRF, search, and igntu.ac.in hostnames.
The official catalogue lists 113 programme cards tagged IGNTU; 11 separate cards tagged RCM were excluded because this task is scoped to the Amarkantak campus.
The official catalogue lists Certificate Course in Communicative Hindi with the literal duration display 0 Year Programme; that value is preserved as shown and should be reviewed by the data owner.

The central official catalogue does not state eligibility for these programme cards, so eligibility is null throughout; mapping gaps in the local career tree were handled with labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings and confidence levels.
